title: Arkret MLS Governance Proof Bundle
description: Complete-materialization proof bundle used by a light client to verify an MLS full-profile governance binding against an accepted Seal. v1 deliberately carries the complete covered-event digest manifest and every non-bottom control-state leaf: a selective proof over server-chosen leaves cannot prove that a policy, capability, membership, or metadata leaf was not omitted. The bundle is content-addressable and cacheable by accepted_seal_id; a future compact profile requires a separately registered completeness-proof construction.

materialization_profile.description: The only v1 profile. covered_event_digests is the entire recursive covered_set of accepted_seal_id and control_state is the entire sorted set of non-bottom joined control cells committed by its state_root.

trust_anchor_seal_id.description: Seal id the verifier already trusts through Realm bootstrap or prior successful verification. Presence in this bundle never makes an anchor trusted.

accepted_seal_id.description: Id of the accepted Seal whose control_event_set_root and state_root authenticate this bundle. It MUST identify the final Seal in seal_path.

seal_path.description: Topologically ordered Seal extension path beginning at the trusted anchor (or its direct successor) and ending at accepted_seal_id. The verifier validates every id, predecessor edge, notary authorization and signature; bundle order is not itself trusted.

covered_event_digests.description: Complete recursive covered_set of accepted_seal_id in canonical wire-value order. The verifier MUST reject duplicates or non-canonical order and MUST recompute accepted Seal.control_event_set_root with the Seal RFC 6962 domain-separated Merkle rules.

control_state.description: Complete canonical cell-id ordered materialization of every non-bottom joined control cell under accepted_seal_id. Bottom cells MUST be omitted and separately cause any dependent full-profile binding to fail closed. The verifier recomputes accepted Seal.state_root over this exact array.

frontier_events.description: Complete set of signed Control Move envelopes named by governance_binding.membership_frontier. The verifier recomputes each Event digest, requires it in covered_event_digests, checks its effects target the registered membership/device/lifecycle coverage families for effective_scope, and rejects missing, extra, duplicate, cross-Realm or cross-scope events.
